social.og_title: WinProx for industry | Faults via QR

industry.title: Report faults. Follow them. Close them.
industry.lead: From a shop-floor fault to a clear task for the right crew. WinProx is one facility app: report technical issues on site, the team completes them.

video.title: See how WinProx works
video.lead: A worker scans the QR code and reports a fault with a photo. Maintenance receives the task and closes it. No app, no phone chain.

problem.title: A fault does not have to become a phone call
problem.lead: A worker notices a problem on a machine, installation or building. WinProx turns that into one workflow — managers follow it through to completion.

items.title: Scan
items.body: The worker scans the QR code on the machine, installation, room or location.

items.title: Report
items.body: The issue is reported on a smartphone. A photo can be added immediately.

items.title: Task
items.body: The report becomes a clear task for the right crew.

items.title: Fix
items.body: Maintenance carries out the task and can add notes.

items.title: Closed
items.body: The task is closed. Managers see what is still open and what is done.

places.title: From a physical place to a digital workflow
places.lead: WinProx ties the report to the place where the problem starts. A QR code can sit on assets such as:
items: machines
cranes
conveyors
technical installations
warehouses
loading docks
plant rooms
buildings
vehicles and other assets
places.close: The worker does not have to find the right department. Scan the QR code and report the problem.

items.title: For workers
items.body: Report in seconds. No app to download and no account: scan the QR code, describe the problem and add a photo if needed.

items.title: For maintenance
items.body: One clear task instead of a chain of calls. Maintenance sees what to do, where it is and what was reported.

items.title: For managers
items.body: Always an overview of what is still open. Follow reports and tasks until they are closed.

sites.title: The same product on site
sites.lead: WinProx is one facility app. In ports, industry and logistics it is the same product — not a separate sector edition.

items.title: Ports and terminals
items.body: Cranes, reach stackers, conveyors, loading gear, plant rooms and buildings.

items.title: Industry
items.body: Production machines, technical installations, warehouses, HVAC, infrastructure and other assets.

items.title: Logistics
items.body: Loading docks, warehouse equipment, doors, gates, lifting gear and technical infrastructure.

why.title: Why WinProx
items: No app for the person who reports: a smartphone and a QR code are enough.
Create locations and teams, place QR codes, start.
A problem becomes a task, not an email lost in an inbox.
Managers follow every report to completion, tied to the location.
A photo with the report gives maintenance context at once.
Reports and tasks in one overview.

start.title: Start small. Grow when it works.
start.lead: You do not have to convert the whole organisation at once. Start with one terminal, one building, one warehouse or one maintenance team.
start.trial: One month free, up to 50 units. No install.

close.title: Ready to try it?
close.lead: Turn every physical place into a simple reporting point. Managers create an account; workers scan and report.
